many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

entry = await rlm.harness.create_memory(title="ARC separated tile count-two marker detection", content="For ARC inputs split by full separator lines into equal rectangular tiles, each tile may contain a uniform background and sparse marker-color cells. A demonstrated rule: produce a compact grid with one output per tile; set that cell to 1 when the tile contains exactly two marker cells, otherwise preserve the input background color. Example: 19x14 separated by color-2 row/column bands into 4x4 tiles (background 9, markers 6) mapped to 4x3 output; exactly-two-marker tiles became 1 and tiles with one marker stayed 9. On a 14x7 input with 2 divider rows/one divider column, the 4x3 blocks had background 4 and markers 7; output was [[1,1],[1,1],[1,4]]. Always count all marker cells in each tile carefully, including cells at any local position.", path="arc", global_=True)
print(entry)
